about: Per-ticket outcomes joined to per-PR exposure, for docs/papers/harbour/coherence-as-it-grows.md. Tickets: every ticket named by a merged PR on origin/main since June 2026 (1,174 joined), read from the workspace proxy on 2026-10-08: comments (count and characters only; send-backs read from the first 400 characters of each), labels, state, and /issues/{id}/cost worker sessions. PRs: every merged PR since January 2026 (1,686). Exposure: whether a PR touched a file that, at the last month-end snapshot before it, held a declared twin, a named twin partner, or a cross-file clone pair (cloneDecision: a pair classed D or F in the codes file).
